entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A one-eyed white-furred leonin planeswalker from Naya, who wears mechanical gauntlets, tracks Grandmother Pashiri to the Dhund, and has vowed not to kill anymore; he is tracking a man who ordered his friend's village burned.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: An elderly renegade lifecrafter and inventor who has had Ajani's gauntlets and cloak made and is trapped in the Dhund's poison chamber.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker poisoned in the Dhund chamber and healed by Ajani.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who is with Chandra and Mrs. Pashiri in the Dhund when Ajani frees them.

entities.name: Shadowblayde
entities.description: A teenage-looking Vahadar elf lifecrafter and renegade with mechanical insects, who gives Ajani a mechanical bird and tells him her real name, Vatti.

entities.name: Tamni
entities.description: A renegade builder who witnessed Pia's arrest and tells Ajani what she saw.

entities.name: Dayal
entities.description: A vedalken boy who admires Shadowblayde and gathers lifecrafters for her.

entities.name: Mihir
entities.description: A renegade whose mechanical birds carry coded messages.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A young nezumi boy whose village was burned and who was adopted into Tamiyo's family on Kamigawa; he befriends Ajani in flashbacks.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A moonfolk scholar who raises Nashi and welcomes Ajani on Kamigawa in flashbacks.

entities.name: Genku
entities.description: Tamiyo's husband who looks after the children.

entities.name: Rumi
entities.description: A loud, gap-toothed moonfolk child of Tamiyo and Genku who loves Ajani's stories.

entities.name: Hiroku
entities.description: Nashi's tallest moonfolk sibling who loves books.

entities.name: Umeyo
entities.description: Nashi's kind cousin who shares ices and takes him to roll rice balls.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A member of Tamiyo's story-circle who tells stories and can walk behind the air.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Ajani's dead friend and hero, a planeswalker whose white cloak he keeps.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalking criminal who ordered Nashi's village burned and who Tamiyo thought had died, now reportedly in power on Kaladesh with a false arm.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: The renegade leader arrested by Consulate inspectors in a trap.

entities.name: Jenrik
entities.description: A local on Innistrad whom Tamiyo works with.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: An aetherborn whose night market hides the Dhund beneath it.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The government of Kaladesh whose inspectors hunt renegades.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Citizens opposed to the Consulate who use secret phrases and codes.

entities.name: Glint-Sleeves
entities.description: A group that crafts bodily attachments such as Ajani's gauntlets.

entities.name: Nezumi
entities.description: Rat-folk of the Kamigawa swamps, Nashi's people.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane where Ajani hunts for Tezzeret and Mrs. Pashiri.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where Tamiyo's family lives and Ajani visits in flashbacks.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The capital city of Kaladesh.

entities.name: Kujar
entities.description: A wealthy green neighborhood of Ghirapur where many Consuls live.

entities.name: Dhund
entities.description: A secret Consulate headquarters of tunnels beneath Gonti's night market that holds important prisoners.

entities.name: Gonti's night market
entities.description: A sprawling illegal exchange in an old energy plant above the Dhund.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Ajani's homeland.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Tamiyo studied the moon.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Ajani went seeking Elspeth.

events.summary: Ajani wears mechanical gauntlets made for him by Glint-Sleeves at Grandmother Pashiri's request while infiltrating Ghirapur.
events.quote: They'd been crafted by the Glint-Sleeves, a group that specialized in such bodily attachments.

events.summary: Ajani finds Grandmother Pashiri's building surrounded by Consulate inspectors.
events.quote: Grandmother's building was surrounded.

events.summary: Ajani sneaks into her ransacked home and knocks two inspectors' heads together.
events.quote: His metal-shrouded hands caught and knocked their heads together.

events.summary: Ajani pins the supervisor to a wall and demands to know where Grandmother Pashiri is.
events.quote: Where is Grandmother Pashiri?

events.summary: The supervisor says she is in custody, trapped as a renegade, and Ajani knocks him out, saying he no longer kills.
events.quote: I don't kill.

events.summary: Ajani follows Grandmother's attar scent across the city like a tracker.
events.quote: It was a different kind of jungle, but he was a tracker.

events.summary: In a flashback, six months ago, Nashi plays hide-and-seek in Tamiyo's library on Kamigawa and finds a pale giant, Ajani, who is welcomed into the household.
events.quote: A pale giant stared down at him. One blue eye blinked.

events.summary: Tamiyo introduces Ajani as part of her story-circle and Nashi as part of her family.
events.quote: He's part of our family now.

events.summary: Tamiyo privately asks Ajani where Elspeth is and he says she is not coming.
events.quote: Where is Elspeth?

events.summary: A blade at his back reveals Shadowblayde, who confirms he is a renegade ally with a secret phrase.
events.quote: A slight pressure settled against the back of his cloak, just hard enough for him to know it as the point of a blade.

events.summary: Shadowblayde says she came looking for Renegade Prime and fears the Consuls took them, and offers to take Ajani to a renegade safe house.
events.quote: I came here looking for Renegade Prime. She was overdue.

events.summary: At the safe house Tamni tells Ajani that Consulate men with a false-armed leader arrested Pia and that Mrs. Pashiri led two women toward Kujar.
events.quote: when I got there, the Consulate had her surrounded

events.summary: Ajani counsels Tamni that charging rashly into battle is foolishness.
events.quote: To charge rashly into battle, unprepared, is not courage.

events.summary: Shadowblayde has Dayal gather renegade lifecrafters with mechanical creatures to search for Mrs. Pashiri.
events.quote: Dayal! Gather the troops.

events.summary: Shadowblayde explains that thousands of lifecrafted creatures across Ghirapur can search faster than one giant.
events.quote: But there's thousands of little creations like ours in Ghirapur.

events.summary: In a flashback, Nashi overhears Tamiyo tell Ajani that Nashi's village was burned by planeswalkers at the behest of the criminal Tezzeret.
events.quote: It was at the behest of a planeswalking criminal named Tezzeret.

events.summary: Nashi remembers fleeing the fire as his mother was burned by a man of living flame.
events.quote: Mama's on fire, held aloft by a man of living flame.

events.summary: Tamiyo says Tezzeret died three years ago, killed by Nashi's villagers and betrayed by comrades.
events.quote: Tezzeret died...three years ago, I think?

events.summary: Tamiyo comforts the sobbing Nashi and tells Ajani that actions have consequences.
events.quote: Actions have consequences,

events.summary: Shadowblayde learns through Mihir's bird that Pashiri was spotted at the Dhund.
events.quote: Pashiri was spotted twenty minutes ago.

events.summary: Shadowblayde explains the Dhund is a secret Consulate headquarters beneath Gonti's night market.
events.quote: The Dhund is a headquarters the Consuls built under and through Gonti's market.

events.summary: Ajani asks Shadowblayde to prepare a fast, secret escape route while he goes in alone.
events.quote: Can you find us a means of escape? Something fast. Secret.

events.summary: Shadowblayde gives Ajani a mechanical bird to lead him to a Dhund entrance.
events.quote: When you're close to a Dhund entrance, he'll fly to it.

events.summary: Ajani shows his face to Shadowblayde, who tells him her real name, Vatti.
events.quote: That's my mundane name. Vatti.

events.summary: Following the mechanical bird, Ajani enters the Dhund and knocks out a guard.
events.quote: He backhanded the guard into the wall and winced at the sudden scent of blood.

events.summary: Ajani sees a hand weakly strike the window of a poison box, and realizes it holds his friends.
events.quote: A fist struck the glass. Then a hand, weakly.

events.summary: In a flashback five months ago Ajani tells Nashi he is leaving Kamigawa to find the man who killed Nashi's family.
events.quote: To find the man who killed your family.

events.summary: Ajani confesses to Nashi that Elspeth is dead and that he lost her.
events.quote: Elspeth is dead.

events.summary: Ajani tells the children Elspeth's story, saying a monster struck her down in front of him.
events.quote: another monster struck her down

events.summary: Ajani whispers that it should have been him, not Elspeth, and the children comfort him.
events.quote: It should have been me. Not her.

events.summary: Ajani vaults the rail, sheds Grandmother's cloak and gauntlets and attacks the guards at the poison chamber.
events.quote: They unclasped and fell away.

events.summary: Ajani swings for a guard's throat but reads his soul and decides he is just a man.
events.quote: Not a Planeswalker. Not a villain.

events.summary: Ajani smashes the guard's chestplate without killing him and sends the other fleeing.
events.quote: It smashed across the guard's chestplate, scattering twisted metal shards across the marble floor.

events.summary: Ajani pries open the poison container door with his axe.
events.quote: he peeled the screeching machine open.

events.summary: Ajani finds Nissa with an unconscious Chandra and Grandmother Pashiri barely breathing.
events.quote: Grandmother lay eyes closed and barely breathing.

events.summary: Ajani heals Grandmother Pashiri's poisoned blood.
events.quote: burning away the black, filling her blood with clean air

events.summary: Ajani heals Chandra's poisoned blood and lungs.
events.quote: Silver tendrils of healing magic raced through her, cleansing the impurities

events.summary: As guards assemble, a rope drops through the window and Ajani leads them out.
events.quote: We have a ride,

events.summary: Ajani lets the guard he struck go home, repeating that he does not kill anymore.
events.quote: Go home to your family,

relations.note: He calls her Grandmother and is helped by her.
She helps him and declares him a renegade.
relations.quote: Now keep that bird in one piece.
Welcome back to Kamigawa, my friend,

relations.note: She was his friend and hero; he keeps her cloak.
relations.quote: This belonged to a friend. Elspeth.
Genku leaned to kiss Tamiyo on the forehead.
Rumi, tell your father to prepare a welcoming meal.

relations.note: She adopted him into her family.
relations.quote: He's part of our family now.

relations.note: His orders led to Nashi's village being burned.
relations.quote: It was at the behest of a planeswalking criminal named Tezzeret.

relations.note: He admires her and gathers troops for her.
They devised the bird codes together.
